# ISoundEffects.Pitch property

How much higher the sound plays, in semitones, from -24 to 24: 12 is an octave higher, and -12 an octave lower. The default is 0. As with a record played faster, a higher sound is also shorter.

```csharp
public float Pitch { get; set; }
```
